newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian railways raise ticket prices by 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italian railways raise ticket prices by 2.5 pct.

text.p: Italy's state-run railway Ferrovie dello Stato said on Friday that it would raise the price of tickets and supplements by around 2.5 percent starting on Saturday.

It said in a statement the price hike followed a decree law issued on the matter by the Transport Ministry, adding that the move was "in line with the inflation-containing policies of the government". -- Rome newsroom 396 678 2501
